notes.title: OPEN BETA AVAILABLE ON STEAM
notes.content:
Exciting news coming at you hot and fresh like bullet to the brain!
All of you loyal Killbox fans will have access to OPEN BETA on STEAM NOW. You will never have a better the chance to get a step ahead of all the others who come late to the firefight. Doesn't that make you feel all warm and fuzzy, just like the grip of your favorite pistol in your hand? Yeah, you know it does.
Get TKB started on STEAM and get awesome PERKS everyday when you log in game! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30812457/9bd108cf8e616fb21fbb62b07e8be32dcfe38366.jpg[/img]
Download Link:http://store.steampowered.com/app/722750/The_Killbox_Arena_Combat/?beta=0 
Google URL:https://goo.gl/nyjrBu 
All of us on TKB Team would like to fistbump of you for your exhaustive efforts to make our game rock, and you all absolutely deserve to get a bonus for your invaluable feedback left in Steam Community. 
Steam Community:https://steamcommunity.com//app/722750/ 
FB Fan Page:https://www.facebook.com/thekillbox2016/ 
FB Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/145618549142588/ 

The Killbox Team out!
